issues.description: The problem statement uses two different method names for the animal feeding action: the UML and tasks define/expect an abstract method messageOnFeed(), but several places in the textual description (e.g., instructions for feedAllAnimals and animal-specific return values) refer to getFeedingSound(). This naming mismatch can confuse students about which method to implement and may lead to implementations that don't match the provided solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Preferably update problem_statement.md to use messageOnFeed() everywhere (replace occurrences of getFeedingSound() with messageOnFeed()), since the UML and the reference solution use messageOnFeed(). Alternatively, if getFeedingSound() is preferred, update the UML, template, and solution to use getFeedingSound() consistently.
